note: the best profit factor of round x3 (0.80, 63% of its catch-up exits winning): reversion into the basket's laggards, no expansion gate.

stop5.title: STOP AT 5 ATR.
stop5.doc: The 3 ATR stop closed 66 trades in round x3, every one a loss. A laggard can fall further before it turns; this gives it 5 ATR.

stop8.title: STOP AT 8 ATR.
stop8.doc: A stop far enough out that it is a disaster stop, not a trading one.

stop2.title: STOP AT 2 ATR.
stop2.doc: The other direction: cut a laggard that keeps lagging sooner.

exit_early.title: TAKE THE CATCH-UP EARLY.
exit_early.doc: Sells once the move is back to -0.5 sigma rather than 0: most of the snap-back, sooner.

exit_overshoot.title: LET IT OVERSHOOT.
exit_overshoot.doc: Holds until the move is +0.5 sigma: a laggard that catches up often runs past its group.

one_tranche.title: ALL IN AT ONCE.
one_tranche.doc: The whole position on the first reversal bar, rather than a third at a time.

lighter_volume.title: LIGHTER VOLUME GATE.
lighter_volume.doc: A tranche needs relative volume of 1.0x (not 1.5x), two need 2.0x. Volume still scales the position; it just gates less.

three_laggards.title: THREE LAGGARDS, SMALLER.
three_laggards.doc: The three weakest names at 27% each instead of two at 40%.

tighter_basket.title: CORRELATION 0.5.
tighter_basket.doc: Opens only in baskets correlated at 0.5 or more, not 0.3.
